chunks: Send Thy choicest blessings and growing favours on Muḥammad Thy servant and Thy Prophet who is the last of those who preceded (him) and an opener for what is closed, proclaimer of truth with truth, repulser of the forces of wrong and crusher of the onslaughts of misguidance. As he was burdened (with responsibility of prophethood) so he bore it standing by Thy commands, advancing towards Thy will, without shrinking of steps or weakness of determination, listening to Thy revelation, preserving Thy testament, proceeding forward in the spreading of Thy commands till he lit fire for its seeker and lighted the path for the groper in the dark. Hearts achieved guidance through him after being ridden with troubles. He introduced clearly guiding signs and shining injunctions. He is Thy trusted trustee, the treasurer of Thy treasured knowledge, Thy witness on the Day of Judgement, Thy envoy of truth and Thy Messenger towards the people.
ai.seo_question: What are the key attributes of Prophet Muhammad described in this supplication from Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi frames this supplication within the Shia tradition of *Tawassul*, emphasizing Muhammad as the *Amin Allah* (Trustee of God) and *Khazin al-Ilm* (Keeper of Hidden Knowledge), a role that underscores the continuity of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt. The text highlights his active endurance (*istifzaz*) in fulfilling his mission, linking his prophetic perfection to the illumination of hearts during the *Fitn* (trials), a concept central to Shia eschatology and historical narrative.
